title: Flattery Rocks National Wildlife Refuge
summary: Along with Copalis and Quillayute Needles, Flattery Rocks was set aside by President Theodore Roosevelt in 1907 as one of the earliest National Wildlife Refuges in an effort to protect and enhance habitat for struggling seabird populations. title: Olympic Coast National Marine Sanctuary
summary: One of the nation’s most treasured ocean areas is Olympic Coast National Marine Sanctuary. In these waters, visitors will find a rich abundance of marine mammals, seabirds, fish, and invertebrate communities.
